en: A bound album titled "Sverige i bilder" containing multiple vintage postcards. The cover is blue with a printed scenic illustration of a waterside building, and the handwritten name "Erik Stef(n)berg" appears below the title. Inside pages show monochrome and tinted postcards depicting Swedish townscapes: a snowy riverside village with wooden houses and a small bridge, a detached wooden house labeled as a locality, a coastal shoreline, and an industrial complex with chimneys and factory buildings. The captions on the cards and album are in Swedish.
